resolved_text_findings: Main-study seven feedback retains versus thirteen initial-final decisions explicitly distinguished.
Shared procedure versus separately frozen implementations/information/feedback/evaluators explicitly stated.
Decision now distinguishes IA physically repeated identical outputs from live/latest delivery aliases.
Decision correctly names all 36 resplit quantities as metrics.
Root README specifies constructor-averaged mean absolute discrepancies.
remaining_limits: Final typeset journal layout, author/ethics/funding disclosures and venue are not verified here.
This audit does not independently recertify all 13 historical dataset families, all old source extraction, or old individual-data computations.
Appended bibliography source metadata was checked by manuscript author; this reviewer confirmed integration but did not repeat those original metadata extractions.
review_tooling_note: Initial final-snapshot bookkeeping failed before write because a slash-specific lookup did not match Windows path separators; normalized the metadata path and repeated aggregate-only checks. No scientific calculation or source output changed.

public_renderer_addendum.scope: Independent static source, current source/output hashes, public/local aggregate equivalence and public-render receipt review. Reviewer did not rerun rendering or clinical analysis.
